pairs.target: huí xuégōng de dìèrtiān , tǎ wéi bǎ nàgēn liáng guò péngzǐ de shéng cóng dài lǐ ná chūlái , cái fāxiàn shàngmiàn zhān zhe yìxiǎopiàn càiyè .
pairs.english: The day after returning to the academy, Tavi took out the cord used to measure the shelter and found a little vegetable leaf stuck to it.
pairs.hanzi: 回学宫的第二天，塔维把那根量过棚子的绳从袋里拿出来，才发现上面沾着一小片菜叶。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō zhè shì tāmen dài huílái de dìyīfèn shíwù , yīnggāi jiá jìn bàogào .
pairs.english: Iven called it their first specimen and said it should go in the report.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说这是他们带回来的第一份实物，应该夹进报告。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ yèzi jiē xiàlái , diū jìn qiángbiān de tǔ pén , jiào tā xiān bǎ zìjǐ xiě fǎn de liǎnggè shù gǎi hǎo .
pairs.english: Mira peeled off the leaf, dropped it in a planter by the wall, and told him to correct his two reversed numbers first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把叶子揭下来，丢进墙边的土盆，叫他先把自己写反的两个数改好。

pairs.target: tāmen zhàn le gōng fāng wài de yìzhāng chángzhuō . jiùzhàn de cǎotú tānkāi yǐhòu , bǐ zuótiān zài fēng lǐ kànzhe luàn dé duō :
pairs.english: They claimed a long table outside the workshop. Spread out, the old station sketch looked far messier than it had in yesterday's wind.
pairs.hanzi: 他们占了工坊外的一张长桌。旧站的草图摊开以后，比昨天在风里看着乱得多：

pairs.target: zhùzi pángbiān yǒu jiàntóu , jiàntóu wàimiàn yòu huà zhe biǎndàn sǎo guò de húxiàn , zuìchū jiā chūqù de yánkǒu zhī shèng yì jié dàndànde yǐngzi .
pairs.english: Arrows stood beside posts, carrying-pole arcs outside the arrows, and only a pale trace remained of the original extended eave.
pairs.hanzi: 柱子旁边有箭头，箭头外面又画着扁担扫过的弧线，最初加出去的檐口只剩一截淡淡的影子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yào chóngxīn miáo yìzhāng gānjìng de , mǐlā què xiān bǎ nà dào húxiàn liúzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi thought they would make a clean copy, but Mira preserved the arc first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为要重新描一张干净的，米拉却先把那道弧线留住。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng huítóu huà zhe huà zhe , yòu bǎ rén zhuǎnshēn de dìfāng wàng le .
pairs.english: She didn't want to forget the turning space again as she drew.
pairs.hanzi: 她不想回头画着画着，又把人转身的地方忘了。

pairs.target: luó shīfu guòlái qǔ gōngjù , jiàn tāmen hái zài zhēng chǐcùn , biàn bǎ mùxiāng gēxià kàn le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Master Luo came to collect tools. Seeing them still arguing over dimensions, he set down his chest and looked for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅过来取工具，见他们还在争尺寸，便把木箱搁下看了一会儿。

pairs.target: tā shuō péng jiǎo lòushuǐ , wèibì zhī kào jiācháng yánkǒu ; kàoshān de jiēfèng yě dé chá .
pairs.english: He said the leaking corner might need more than a longer eave; the mountain-facing joint needed inspecting too.
pairs.hanzi: 他说棚角漏水，未必只靠加长檐口；靠山的接缝也得查。

pairs.target: xiànzài zhèxiē shù néng yòng , xiū fǎ què hái bùnéng dìng .
pairs.english: These measurements were usable, but the repair method couldn't yet be decided.
pairs.hanzi: 现在这些数能用，修法却还不能定。

pairs.target: tā xiàcì guòqù huì xiānkāi nà yìxiǎokuài kàn , zài bǎ jiéguǒ dài huílái .
pairs.english: Next visit, he would lift that small section to look, then bring back what he found.
pairs.hanzi: 他下次过去会掀开那一小块看，再把结果带回来。

pairs.target: mǐlā tīng wán , jìng méiyǒu xiǎnde shīwàng . tā zài kōng chù xiě le " dài kàn jiēfèng ", bǎ zìjǐ zuótiān de shuǐyìn jiàntóu quān shàng .
pairs.english: Surprisingly, Mira didn't seem disappointed. She wrote “joint awaiting inspection” in the margin and circled yesterday's water-stain arrow.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉听完，竟没有显得失望。她在空处写了“待看接缝”，把自己昨天的水印箭头圈上。

pairs.target: " nà wǒmen xiān bǎ jìnchū de dìfāng huà qīngchǔ . "
pairs.english: “Then let's make the entrances clear first.”
pairs.hanzi: “那我们先把进出的地方画清楚。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō zhè jù huà yīnggāi fàngzài bàogào dìyīháng , miǎnde biérén yìlái jiù kàn tāmen huà de wūdǐng .
pairs.english: Iven said that should be the report's first line, so people wouldn't look straight at the roof they had drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说这句话应该放在报告第一行，免得别人一来就看他们画的屋顶。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ bǐ dìgěi tā , ràng tā xiě , bié zhī zài pángbiān shuō .
pairs.english: Mira handed him the pen: write it, don't just talk from the sidelines.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把笔递给他，让他写，别只在旁边说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù xǐ shéng shí , tā gēn le guòlái , ná zhe yào chōngdiào ní de zhíchǐ .
pairs.english: When Tavi went to wash the cord, she followed with a muddy ruler to rinse.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去洗绳时，她跟了过来，拿着要冲掉泥的直尺。

pairs.target: shuǐcáo hěnzhǎi , liǎnggè rén de shǒu zǒng pèngdào yìqǐ , tā wǎng zuǒ nuó , tā yě zhèng wǎng zuǒ nuó , zuìhòu dōu tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: The trough was narrow and their hands kept bumping. He shifted left just as she did; finally both stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 水槽很窄，两个人的手总碰到一起，他往左挪，她也正往左挪，最后都停住了。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiān . " tā shuō . tǎ wéi bǎ shéng shàng de shuǐ lǚ xiàlái , tīngjiàn tā yòu kāikǒu .
pairs.english: “You first,” she said. Tavi squeezed water from the cord and heard her speak again.
pairs.hanzi:
“你先。”她说。
塔维把绳上的水捋下来，听见她又开口。

pairs.target: " zuótiān qiáo shàng , wǒ cuī nǐ le . duìbùqǐ . "
pairs.english: “I hurried you on the bridge yesterday. I'm sorry.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨天桥上，我催你了。对不起。”

pairs.target: tā shǒulǐ de shéng tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The cord in his hands paused.
pairs.hanzi: 他手里的绳停了一下。

pairs.target: " nǐ yuè shuō zǒu , wǒ yuè juéde zìjǐ dǔ zhe biérén . "
pairs.english: “The more you told me to go, the more I felt I was blocking everyone.”
pairs.hanzi: “你越说走，我越觉得自己堵着别人。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào le . xiàcì xiān wèn nǐ . "
pairs.english: “I understand now. Next time I'll ask you first.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道了。下次先问你。”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ shuǐkǒu rànggěi tā .
pairs.english: He nodded and let her have the water spout.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，把水口让给她。

pairs.target: mǐlā dītóu xǐ chǐ , méiyǒu zàishuō mùbǎn hǎohǎo de , yě méi wèn tā xiànzài hái qìbuqì .
pairs.english: Mira lowered her head to wash the ruler, saying nothing more about the sound boards and not asking if he was still angry.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉低头洗尺，没有再说木板好好的，也没问他现在还气不气。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán hěn xiǎng jiǎng yīwén zài zhōng tái nà zhāng liǎn ,
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly wanted to mention Iven's face on the middle platform.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然很想讲伊文在中台那张脸，

pairs.target: huà kuài chūkǒu , yòu xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ yě zài nàlǐ zuò le bàntiān , biàn zhī xiào le yíxià .
pairs.english: But just as the words came, he remembered how long he had sat there himself and only smiled.
pairs.hanzi: 话快出口，又想起自己也在那里坐了半天，便只笑了一下。

pairs.target: wǔfàn hòu , tā bǎ jiù tánhuáng ná chūlái , zhàozhe nài lěi dehuà huà le dàxiǎo hé biānshàng de quēkǒu .
pairs.english: After lunch, he took out the old spring and drew its size and edge notch as Nerai had suggested.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭后，他把旧弹簧拿出来，照着奈蕾的话画了大小和边上的缺口。

pairs.target: nà quēkǒu shì mósǔn háishì yuánlái jiù yǒu , tā bù zhīdào , zài pángbiān liú le yígè wènhào .
pairs.english: He didn't know if the notch was wear or always had been there, so left a question mark beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 那缺口是磨损还是原来就有，他不知道，在旁边留了一个问号。

pairs.target: yīwén kànjiàn le , shuō jīntiān jiù cè shì kāimén , kěyǐ qù wèn .
pairs.english: Seeing it, Iven said the old-ledger room was open today; they could ask there.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看见了，说今天旧册室开门，可以去问。

pairs.target: tā yào hái yìběn jièlái de dì túcè , zhènghǎo tónglù .
pairs.english: He had a borrowed atlas to return and was going that way anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 他要还一本借来的地图册，正好同路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ tánhuáng guǒhǎo , lián cǎotú yìqǐ dàishàng , méiyǒu děng xià yìfēng huíxìn .
pairs.english: Tavi wrapped the spring and took it with the sketch, without waiting for another reply.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把弹簧裹好，连草图一起带上，没有等下一封回信。

pairs.target: jiù cè shì zài dōnglóu xiàcéng , jìnmén xiān wéndào cháo zhǐ hé shàiguò mùbǎn de qìwèi .
pairs.english: The old-ledger room was on the lower floor of the east building; damp paper and sun-dried wood were the first smells through the door.
pairs.hanzi: 旧册室在东楼下层，进门先闻到潮纸和晒过木板的气味。

pairs.target: zhí zhuō de nǚrén kàn le tā de tú , méiyǒu lìkè lǐng tāmen qù fānshū , xiān wèn tā yào chá míngzì , háishì yào chá zhè piàn dōngxī shénme shíhòu yùn lái .
pairs.english: The woman at the desk looked at his drawing. Instead of immediately taking them to the books, she first asked whether he wanted a name or the date this piece had arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 值桌的女人看了他的图，没有立刻领他们去翻书，先问他要查名字，还是要查这片东西什么时候运来。

pairs.target: " xiānchá zhège yìn . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “The mark first,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “先查这个印。”塔维说。

pairs.target: tā cóng chōutì lǐ qǔchū báobáo yícè yàng yìn suǒyǐn , jiào tā àn xíngzhuàng zhǎo , zhuōshàng bié fàng shuǐhú .
pairs.english: She took a thin stamp index from a drawer, telling him to search by shape and keep water flasks off the table.
pairs.hanzi: 她从抽屉里取出薄薄一册样印索引，叫他按形状找，桌上别放水壶。

pairs.target: tánhuáng kěyǐ liúzài bù shàng , bùxǔ zhíjiē yā jiù zhǐ .
pairs.english: The spring could stay on its cloth, but mustn't press directly on old paper.
pairs.hanzi: 弹簧可以留在布上，不许直接压旧纸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià lái , yíyè yiyè fān . yuán de , jiāochā de , xiàng yèzi de .
pairs.english: Tavi sat and turned page after page. Round ones, crossed ones, leaflike ones.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐下来，一页一页翻。圆的，交叉的，像叶子的。

pairs.target: yǒu jǐgè yuǎn kàn xiàng liǎngdào yuèyá , kàojìn cái fāxiàn shì yìzhī jiáqián , huòzhě liǎngtiáo huà wān de yú .
pairs.english: Several looked like two crescents from afar; up close, they proved to be pincers or two curved fish.
pairs.hanzi: 有几个远看像两道月牙，靠近才发现是一只夹钳，或者两条画弯的鱼。

pairs.target: tā fān màn le , yīwén yě méi tì tā qiǎngguòqù , zhī bāng tā rèn pángbiān de xiǎozì .
pairs.english: He slowed down, and Iven didn't take over, only helping him read the small print alongside.
pairs.hanzi: 他翻慢了，伊文也没替他抢过去，只帮他认旁边的小字。

pairs.target: zhǎodào liǎngdào xiāngxiàng de húxiàn shí , tǎ wéi bǎshǒu tíng zài le zhǐbiān . " zhège ? "
pairs.english: When he found two arcs facing each other, Tavi stilled his hand at the page's edge. “This one?”
pairs.hanzi:
找到两道相向的弧线时，塔维把手停在了纸边。
“这个？”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu mǎshàng bǎ tánhuáng tiēshàngqù .
pairs.english: He didn't immediately lay the spring against it.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有马上把弹簧贴上去。

pairs.target: xiān kàn húxiàn kāikǒu de fāngxiàng , zài kàn zhòngjiān de jiàngé , zuìhòu bǎ zìjǐ de tú yí dào pángbiān .
pairs.english: First he checked which way the arcs opened, then the gap between them, and finally placed his own drawing alongside.
pairs.hanzi: 先看弧线开口的方向，再看中间的间隔，最后把自己的图移到旁边。

pairs.target: zhí zhuō de nǚrén guòlái kàn le yìyǎn , àn yè biān de hào zhǎochū lìng yícè , tān zài yíkuài xié mùbǎn shàng .
pairs.english: The desk attendant came over, took a look, and used the number at the page edge to find another ledger, opening it on a slanted wooden support.
pairs.hanzi: 值桌的女人过来看了一眼，按页边的号找出另一册，摊在一块斜木板上。

pairs.target: nà shì èrshíduōnián qián de gòngliào cè . yìn yàng pángbiān xiě zhe wǔgè zì : wù wān jī zuò suǒ .
pairs.english: It was a supply ledger more than twenty years old. Beside the stamp sample stood five characters: Mistbay Works.
pairs.hanzi: 那是二十多年前的供料册。印样旁边写着五个字：雾湾机作所。

pairs.target: yīwén niàn le yíbiàn , tǎ wéi gēnzhe niàn , què zài " wān " zì shàng dùnzhù .
pairs.english: Iven read it once; Tavi repeated it, stumbling on the character for “bay.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文念了一遍，塔维跟着念，却在“湾”字上顿住。

pairs.target: nǚrén ná yìzhāng fèizhǐ xiě dà le gěi tā kàn , gàosù tā , zhè cè dēngjì de shì gònghuò yìn ;
pairs.english: The woman wrote it large on scrap paper and explained that this ledger registered suppliers' marks.
pairs.hanzi: 女人拿一张废纸写大了给他看，告诉他，这册登记的是供货印；

pairs.target: néng chá dào yòng zhège yìn de míngzì , bù děngyú zhè piàn tiě de láilù yǐjīng quán chá míngbái .
pairs.english: Finding the name that used this stamp didn't mean the piece of iron's entire history was now known.
pairs.hanzi: 能查到用这个印的名字，不等于这片铁的来路已经全查明白。

pairs.target: yè xiàliè zhe hǎojǐzhǒng huò : dànpiàn , tàohuán , duǎn zhóu .
pairs.english: Below were several kinds of goods: spring strips, collars, short shafts.
pairs.hanzi: 页下列着好几种货：弹片、套环、短轴。

pairs.target: pángbiān de shōuhuò dì yě bùzhǐ yígè . tǎ wéi shùnzhe kàn xiàqù , rènchū le tóng jiē chéng , háiyǒu liǎngchù bú rènshi .
pairs.english: There was more than one receiving destination alongside. Reading down, Tavi recognized Copperstep and found two other unfamiliar places.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边的收货地也不止一个。塔维顺着看下去，认出了铜阶城，还有两处不认识。

pairs.target: zhè piàn tánhuáng shì tā zài lú chǎng fēn dào de jiùliào , búshì cóngxiǎo dài zài shēnshàng de xìnwù .
pairs.english: This spring was scrap allotted to him at the furnace yard, not a keepsake carried since childhood.
pairs.hanzi: 这片弹簧是他在炉场分到的旧料，不是从小带在身上的信物。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào tā bùnéng tì zìjǐ huídá chūshēng zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: He knew it couldn't answer where he was born.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道它不能替自己回答出生在哪里。

pairs.target: kě zhèmejiǔ yǐlái , tā shǒulǐ zhī wò zhe liǎngdào āo yìn , xiànzài zhōngyú yǒu yígè néng niàn chūlái , néng jìxù wèn xiàqù de míngzì .
pairs.english: Yet all this time he'd held only two impressions; now at last there was a name he could pronounce and keep asking about.
pairs.hanzi: 可这么久以来，他手里只握着两道凹印，现在终于有一个能念出来、能继续问下去的名字。

pairs.target: tā bǎ nà wǔgè zì chāoxiàlái , yòu chāo le cè míng hé yè hào .
pairs.english: He copied the five characters, then the ledger's title and page number.
pairs.hanzi: 他把那五个字抄下来，又抄了册名和页号。

pairs.target: yīwén zhǐ gěi tā kàn lòudiào de yìbǐ , děng tā zìjǐ bǔ .
pairs.english: Iven pointed out a missing stroke and waited for him to add it himself.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文指给他看漏掉的一笔，等他自己补。

pairs.target: zhí zhuō de nǚrén shuō , lìng yǒu jiào xīn de mùlù , yào děng guǎn nà pái guìzi de rén huílái cáinéng qǔ .
pairs.english: The attendant said there was a newer catalog, but the keeper of that row of cupboards had to return before it could be taken out.
pairs.hanzi: 值桌的女人说，另有较新的目录，要等管那排柜子的人回来才能取。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn nǎ tiān xiàwǔ fāngbiàn . tā shuō zài guò liǎngtiān , tā biàn bǎ rìzi jì zài míngzì xiàmiàn , méiyǒu yāoqiú tā xiànzài qù zhǎo yàoshi .
pairs.english: Tavi asked which afternoon would suit. She said in two days, so he wrote the day beneath the name without demanding she fetch the key now.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问哪天下午方便。她说再过两天，他便把日子记在名字下面，没有要求她现在去找钥匙。

pairs.target: zǒu chūlái shí , yuànzi lǐ de guāng yǐjīng xié le . mǐlā zuòzài cháng zhuōbiān , bǎ bàogào yā zài gēbo xià děng mò gān ,
pairs.english: When they came out, the courtyard light had slanted. Mira sat at the long table, holding the report beneath her arm while the ink dried.
pairs.hanzi: 走出来时，院子里的光已经斜了。米拉坐在长桌边，把报告压在胳膊下等墨干，

pairs.target: jiàn tāmen guòlái , wèn chá dào le méiyǒu . " chá dào yígè míngzì . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: Seeing them, she asked whether they had found anything. “A name,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi:
见他们过来，问查到了没有。
“查到一个名字。”塔维说。
